name: Cosmic Cycling
body:
You can grant someone a temporary boost that stems from your continued research into the harmony between body and spirit.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Cosmic Soul Expert, and Cosmic Guidance.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic cycling ability.

Cosmic Cycling (Su)

Once per day, as a standard action, you may touch a target creature to grant them the following benefit. The target creature may use their highest ability score at the time in lieu of one of their lower ability scores of their choice. Once this choice is made, the effect lasts a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your HD. This modifies accordingly all statistics and checks related to ability scores, with the following exceptions:

Hit Points: hit points gained in this way are treated as temporary hit points instead.
Skills and Spells: skills ranks and bonus spell slots do not change.
Other: daily uses or frequency for any ability, feat, or effect the creature possesses do not change.

A creature can only be under the effects of one use of cosmic cycling at any given time. Certain statistics from optional rules may not be affected by this ability, subject to the GM’s discretion.

Special: You may expend 4 ki points or 4 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic cycling. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic cycling in this way once for every 6 HD you possess.
